proposal.summary: The report states a buffer overflow in timg (hzeller) v1.5.1 and earlier that allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the 0x61200000045c address.
proposal.cwe_quote: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in hzeller timg v.1.5.1 and before allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the 0x61200000045c address.
proposal.recommended_next_step: Request a proof-of-concept or crash trigger and details about the vulnerable code path (input vector, parsing function) and whether exploitation can lead to code execution; if confirmed, prepare coordinated disclosure and patches.

evidence_quotes.quote: Buffer Overflow vulnerability in hzeller timg v.1.5.1 and before allows a remote attacker to cause a denial of service via the 0x61200000045c address.
